topic: Original fixed determinant and trace-zero condition; actual continuous adjoint H1 quotient and restriction

primarySources.title: The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
primarySources.author: Gaetan Chenevier
primarySources.review: Remark 2.29 relates the determinant tangent space to adjoint H1 for an irreducible representation. Section 2.30 treats topology separately. Our representation-lift classification does not require or claim determinant reconstruction.
primarySources.formalUse: Construct the actual continuous cocycle quotient and compare its equality relation with the original algebraic H1 for these continuous cocycles. Prove continuous-lift classification and original restriction. No identification of all algebraic H1 with continuous H1 is claimed.

primarySources.title: Symmetric power functoriality for holomorphic modular forms, II
primarySources.authors: James Newton and Jack A. Thorne
primarySources.locations: Introduction; Theorem2.1; section2 fixed-determinant local deformation rings; Lemma2.7
primarySources.review: The arithmetic lifting argument uses deformation and pseudodeformation rings, local conditions, patched modules and adjoint Selmer information.
primarySources.formalUse: Prove the exact first-order determinant/trace-zero condition for original matrix lifts. Full fixed-determinant deformation representability, local p-adic Hodge conditions, Galois association, patching and Selmer vanishing remain unproved.
